digest.component_or_area: sidecar channel and gate error telemetry
propositions: The sidecar channel records gate-run resource limits (request_limit, tool_calls_limit) but does not record actual resource consumption (requests, tool_calls) due to sanitization allowlist filtering in failure.py
Five of six emit_gate_error call sites in gate_dispatch.py pass no diagnostic parameter, resulting in no consumption counters being recorded for plan-review and code-review gate failures
The completion verdict sidecar lacks per-run metrics (requests, tool_calls, duration) that already exist in the plan-review sidecar, creating asymmetric instrumentation between the two gates
Consumption metrics must reach the ticket store via the sidecar channel to be answerable globally via rebar audit show, not only locally in per-checkout usage logs
